headline: Seduta in prevalenza negativa a Wall Street: Coherent Corp. +13,58% guida i rialzi
headline_en: Broadly negative session on Wall Street: Coherent Corp. +13.58% leads gainers

Settori con la variazione media migliore: Information Technology (+1,37%); Health Care (+0,02%); Communication Services (-0,05%). Settori piu' debolli: Consumer Staples (-1,25%); Real Estate (-1,00%); Financials (-0,90%).

Cl A stock rises Friday, outperforms market»; Advanced Micro Devices (AMD, +11,04%). Insulet Corporation fell 6.16 percent and Dexcom declined 5.98 percent; tracked outlets report no specific company catalyst for Dexcom's session. Centene Corporation slid 5.97 percent without a reported catalyst. Dollar Tree fell 4.93 percent after a hot run, per Reuters, while Expedia Group declined 4.86 percent as US-Iran war fallout prolongs pressure on travel firms, according to Reuters.
